en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town in a river valley, with fields and hills in the background. Prominently visible on the right is a large round medieval stone tower with a conical roof, surrounded by trees and houses. Smokestacks and village buildings appear in the middle ground. In the top left corner, the caption reads "CAMBURG a. Saale". The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
